visual_goal: Show a shared physical layer (property, unit, beds) underneath two different commercial layers: room types and rate plans forming products on one side, a listing on one unit on the other.
prompt: A two-level layered illustration. The bottom level is a wide teal platform labeled 'Physical layer', holding, left to right: a building labeled 'Property', a row of identical apartment doors labeled 'Unit', and a bed labeled 'Beds'. One arrow from 'Property' to 'Unit' and one arrow from 'Unit' to 'Beds'. The top level is split into two separate raised panels. The left blue panel holds three boxes in one horizontal row: 'Rate plan' on the left, 'Product' in the middle, 'Room type' on the right; one arrow from 'Rate plan' into 'Product' and one arrow from 'Room type' into 'Product'. From the bottom edge of the 'Room type' box itself, one dashed arrow goes straight down to the row of doors, labeled 'groups'; no dashed line touches 'Rate plan' or 'Product'. The right orange panel holds one card labeled 'Listing', with one dashed arrow straight down to a single door at the right end of the row, labeled 'publishes'.
alt: A shared physical layer of property, unit and beds under two commercial panels: room type and rate plan forming products that group units, and a listing that publishes one unit.

visual_goal: Show each marketplace's supply catalog keyed to one place registry, with catalog events feeding calendars, search and reservations, and reporting reading unit IDs.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration. Far left: a small group of generic tools (a laptop and a phone) labeled 'Partner tools', with one arrow into a large filing cabinet labeled 'Supply catalog'. Below the cabinet, a register book with a map pin labeled 'Place registry', with one arrow from the cabinet down into it labeled 'unit IDs'. To the right of the cabinet, three stacked boxes: a calendar grid labeled 'Calendar', a magnifying glass labeled 'Search', and a confirmation slip labeled 'Reservations'. One arrow from the cabinet into each of the three boxes; the arrow to the calendar is labeled 'catalog events'. At the far right, a document with a stamp labeled 'Reporting', with one arrow from 'Reservations' into it and one arrow from 'Place registry' into it.
alt: Partner tools write a supply catalog that registers unit IDs in a place registry and publishes catalog events to calendar, search and reservations, with reporting reading both reservations and the registry.

visual_goal: Show that for pooled inventory the guest books a room type and the specific unit is assigned later, flowing back to Roomstead and then to reporting.
prompt: A left-to-right swimlane illustration with five vertical lanes, each headed by a small icon and label: a generic guest figure labeled 'Guest', a plain booking-platform box labeled 'Roomstead', a plain connector box labeled 'Corvane Connect', a small hotel desk computer labeled 'PMS', and a stamped document labeled 'Reporting'. Messages as horizontal arrows going down the page in order: an arrow from 'Guest' to 'Roomstead' labeled 'book One-Bedroom'; an arrow from 'Roomstead' to 'Corvane Connect' labeled 'room-type pool'; an arrow from 'Corvane Connect' to 'PMS' labeled 'reservation'; a later arrow from 'PMS' back to 'Corvane Connect' labeled 'unit Granada 3A'; an arrow from 'Corvane Connect' back to 'Roomstead' labeled 'unit ID'; an arrow from 'Roomstead' to 'Reporting' labeled 'stay facts'. A soft clock icon sits beside the 'unit Granada 3A' arrow to show it comes later.
alt: Swimlanes for guest, Roomstead, Corvane Connect, PMS and reporting: a room-type booking is delivered, the PMS assigns unit Granada 3A later, and the unit ID flows back to Roomstead and into reporting.
